parameters.name: DatasetName
parameters.description: The dataset name. For more information about how to obtain the dataset name, see [Create a dataset](~~478160~~).

parameters.name: Files
parameters.description: A list of OSS files. This is an array in JSON format that can contain up to 100 files.

parameters.name: Notification
parameters.description: The notification configuration. For more information, click Notification. For the format of asynchronous notification messages, see the metadata indexing section in [Asynchronous notification message formats](~~2743997~~).

parameters.name: ProjectName
parameters.description: The project name. For more information about how to obtain the project name, see [Create a project](~~478153~~).

parameters.name: UserData
parameters.description: Custom user data. This parameter takes effect only when you specify an MNS configuration for the Notification parameter. The data is returned in the asynchronous notification message, which you can use to associate the message with your services. The maximum length is 2048 bytes.
